welcome-wms.title: Welcome to Warehouse Management System (WMS)
welcome-wms.description: WMS (Warehouse Management System) is an intelligent solution designed to optimize warehouse operations. It enhances logistics efficiency and accuracy through automated inventory management, real-time order processing, and intelligent storage layout. The system supports seamless integration with ERP, TMS, etc., enabling full supply chain collaboration to help enterprises reduce operational costs and improve customer satisfaction.
welcome-wms.download-description: Manage warehouse anytime, anywhere with more efficient mobile operations
welcome-wms.download-description-more: Break free from fixed workstations! The mobile APP allows real-time synchronization of warehouse dynamics. Complete inbound, outbound, transfer, and counting operations by scanning codes anywhere. Improve on-site efficiency for smarter, more flexible warehouse management!

tooltips.total: Total Inventory: Includes on-hand, damaged, returned, sorted, picked, and packed.
tooltips.received: Received: Quantity received but not yet sorted. Not included in total inventory calculation.
tooltips.asn: ASN Inventory: Pre-arrival notification confirmed but not physically arrived. Not included in current inventory calculation.
tooltips.dn: DN Inventory: Outbound order waiting for picking. Generated DN not yet picked. Excluded from current inventory calculation.
tooltips.low-threshold: Low threshold: Triggers restock request when inventory falls below this level.
tooltips.high-threshold: High threshold: Triggers clearance request when inventory exceeds this level.
tooltips.available: Available Stock: Current stock quantity ready for use (includes physical on-hand + damaged + returned items), excluding locked and pending outbound inventory.
tooltips.sale: Sellable Stock: Current stock quantity available for sale, excluding locked and pending outbound inventory.

tips.cancel-confirm: ADJ-{id} will be cancelled. Stock is not changed, and it can no longer be approved or completed. This cannot be undone.

ASN-{id} will be cancelled: the received quantities are taken back out of received stock, its sorting task is deactivated and the ASN is closed. An ASN whose sorting has started cannot be cancelled. This cannot be undone.
DN-{id} will be cancelled: the stock it reserves is released, its picking task is deactivated and the DN is closed. A DN whose picking has started cannot be cancelled. This cannot be undone.
tips.cancel-confirm-picked: DN-{id} will be cancelled: picked / packed goods are returned to stock awaiting putaway and must be put away again; reservations are released, related tasks are deactivated and the DN is closed. If the DN has an unfinished carrier shipment, cancel it in the Export shipment section of the packing or delivery task first. This cannot be undone.
